description: Na₂VO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmc2₁ space group. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one VO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.62 Å. V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (1.77 Å) and two longer (1.91 Å) V-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent V atoms to form distorted ONa₂V₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with eight equivalent ONa₄V trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₂V₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄V trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Na and one V atom to form distorted ONa₄V trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent ONa₄V trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent ONa₂V₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with four equivalent ONa₄V trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂V₂ trigonal pyramid.
